spans.claim: The victim was James Beardmore, shot in the wood
spans.anchor: found Jim Beardmore lying on his face, and he was quite dead
spans.span: Twenty paces along the woodland path they found Jim Beardmore lying on his face, and he was quite dead, and even as Jack was staring down at his father with horrified eyes, a girl emerged from the wood at the farther end, and stopping only long enough to wipe with a handful of grass something that was red from her hands, she flew along the shadow of the hedge which divided the Froyant estate.

spans.claim: Thalia Drummond was arrested for theft of a golden Buddha
spans.anchor: I charge her with theft. You shall go to prison for this
spans.span: I charge her with theft. You shall go to prison for this.

spans.claim: Felix Marl showed panic and fear near the crime scene
spans.anchor: the stout Mr. Marl emitted a frightened squeal and leapt back
spans.span: They were nearing the house when suddenly and for no obvious reason the stout Mr. Marl emitted a frightened squeal and leapt back.

spans.claim: Marl’s pointed patent boots were found to have chalk dust
spans.anchor: there is dust on them, and the ground has been wet for the last week
spans.span: there is dust on them, and the ground has been wet for the last week.

spans.claim: Marl was murdered by poison gas bubbles blown into his room
spans.anchor: They blew bubbles. The end of this cylinder was first dipped into the soap solution

spans.claim: ‘Flush’ Barnet broke into Marl’s house but found no money
spans.anchor: He opened the safe--that was easy--and I found the envelope, but it had no papers

spans.claim: Harvey Froyant was murdered with a knife and a gauntlet glove
spans.anchor: Harvey Froyant was dead. The handle of a knife projected from his left breast
spans.span: Harvey Froyant was dead. The handle of a knife projected from his left breast, a knife with a steel cup-like guard.

spans.claim: Thalia Drummond’s footprints were found in Froyant’s garden
spans.anchor: Here is a recent footprint, and a woman’s!

spans.claim: Derrick Yale was chloroformed and handcuffed in his office
spans.anchor: Stretched upon the ground, his wrists fastened with handcuffs, his ankles strapped
spans.span: Stretched upon the ground, his wrists fastened with handcuffs, his ankles strapped, and a towel over his face lay the prostrate figure of Derrick Yale.

spans.claim: Thalia Drummond escaped from Holloway prison mysteriously
spans.anchor: At six o’clock when the cell door was opened, Drummond was missing
spans.span: At six o'clock when the cell door was opened, Drummond was missing.

spans.claim: Derrick Yale is the Crimson Circle leader with a red birthmark
spans.anchor: Red, blood-red, as though it were painted by human agency, a circle of crimson ran about the throat of Derrick Yale
spans.span: Red, blood-red, as though it were painted by human agency, a circle of crimson ran about the throat of Derrick Yale.

spans.claim: Thalia Drummond is Derrick Yale’s daughter and accomplice
spans.anchor: Thalia Drummond Parr, that is my name
spans.span: Thalia Drummond Parr, that is my name.

spans.claim: Yale murdered Froyant using a concealed knife and glove
spans.anchor: On the hand was a motor-driver’s gauntlet, and in that hand was the knife that slew Froyant

spans.claim: Marl was killed because he recognized Yale and posed a threat
spans.anchor: Marl was eventually destroyed, the murderer employing perhaps the most ingenious method
spans.span: More unfortunate still, Marl recognised Lightman when he met him in England, and this is the reason why Marl was eventually destroyed, the murderer employing perhaps the most ingenious method that has ever been used by a homicidal criminal.

spans.claim: Yale faked his own chloroform attack to divert suspicion
spans.anchor: Yale handcuffed, strapped and chloroformed himself after he had put the money in an envelope
spans.span: Yale handcuffed, strapped and chloroformed himself after he had put the money in an envelope and dropped it down the letter-chute--it was addressed to his private residence.

spans.claim: Thalia Drummond stabbed Raphael Willings but saved his life
spans.anchor: Near by the curtain Raphael Willings lay on his face, three inches of Assyrian dagger in his shoulder
spans.span: Near by the curtain Raphael Willings lay on his face, three inches of Assyrian dagger in his shoulder, and standing by him, staring down at him was a white-faced girl.

spans.claim: The Crimson Circle’s organization is highly secretive and compartmentalized
spans.anchor: You have a hundred comrades, none of whom will ever be known to you
spans.span: You have a hundred comrades, none of whom will ever be known to you, none of whom will ever know you.

spans.claim: The Crimson Circle sent threatening letters demanding money
spans.anchor: You will pay this in notes to a messenger I will send in response
spans.span: You will pay this in notes to a messenger I will send in response to an advertisement in the 'Tribune' within the next twenty-four hours, stating the exact hour convenient to you.

spans.claim: Thalia Drummond was used to gather intelligence on government ministers
spans.anchor: I wish you to know this man thoroughly and discover what are his little weaknesses
spans.span: I wish you to know this man thoroughly and discover what are his little weaknesses.
